title: An Ethernet Address Resolution Protocol

claims_extracted.claim: RFC 826 defines dynamic translation from protocol addresses to local Ethernet hardware addresses.
claims_extracted.locator: RFC 826 problem statement and packet format

claims_extracted.claim: ARP remains a directly recognizable IPv4/Ethernet local-neighbor mechanism even though IPv6 adopted a different Neighbor Discovery architecture.
claims_extracted.locator: RFC 826 mechanism; modern IPv4 deployment continuity to be supported by implementation sources
claims_extracted.notes: Do not claim ARP is universal across all successor Internet protocols.

notes: Important example of a mechanism that remained long-lived within IPv4 LANs without becoming the universal neighbor-discovery model for IPv6.
